title: HPS Seminar: Dilemmas of modernity (cont.)
reading: A.N. Whitehead, Science and the Modern World ([1925] Free Press 2010): chapters 7–13 (pp. 142–260)
description: HPS Seminar (coordinated by Daan Wegener and Antonio Ferreiro de Aguiar). Participants read the text in advance and send their reading notes a day before. In person only. Snacks and refreshments provided. Also listed in F.A. Muller's Research Seminar Philosophy of Physics (which gives 15:15–17:00). Without a UU access pass, enter the BBG via the Minnaert Building.
